summary: Iter 22 certification: Auth security posture (X-Return-Token gated by ALLOW_TEST_TOKEN_HEADER env), Marketplace (public catalog + featured + course detail + opt-in gate), Live Sessions (admin CRUD + learner RSVP + attendance + cohort filter + ICS + role-based UI) — ALL DELIVERABLES GREEN. Backend full regression: 486 passed / 3 skipped / 0 failures (489 tests total, iter22_full.xml). 17/17 new iter-22 tests pass on the public preview URL. Frontend E2E validated end-to-end via Playwright: anonymous marketplace → course detail → /register?next=&auto_enroll=1 handoff, admin schedule-session modal → session card with Join/.ics/Attendance buttons, learner /live-sessions with role-gated UI + RSVP toggle (RSVP ↔ RSVP'd) + toast integration + .ics download, admin settings marketplace-opt-in-row visible with toggle state=true.
action_items: OPTIONAL: The stray `iter30l-audit-1783073838` active TermsVersion (id=6) was still present in DB at test start — I cleaned it (row + its acceptances). Main agent should audit the iter30l teardown path so no leftover current=true rows remain post-suite; consider adding a guard in scripts/build_docs.py or seed script to demote any test-named versions on boot.

critical_code_review_comments: ALLOW_TEST_TOKEN_HEADER gate: verified — with the env var set to true (dev), POST /api/auth/login with X-Return-Token: true DOES return access_token in body. Cookie-mode still primary (HttpOnly + CSRF). Correct posture for production hardening.
/api/catalog returns full pagination shape {courses, categories, total, page, page_size}. Every course carries an organization={id,name,logo_url} block. page_size defaults to 24 (<=100).
/api/catalog/{id} returns syllabus_preview (verified len 5 <= 8) + organization block; 404 on unknown id.

Marketplace opt-in gate: PATCH /api/organization {marketplace_opt_in: false} hides the org's courses from public /api/catalog. GET /api/organization surfaces the flag. Toggling back restores catalog. Verified in the module-scoped iter22 marketplace test.

Live Sessions router: proper 201/200/204 status codes; DELETE returns 204 and subsequent GET is 404. Learner cannot POST (401/403). RSVP toggle status flips RSVP ↔ CANCELLED with counts excluding CANCELLED. Bulk mark-attendance auto-creates walk-in RSVPs. Learner /upcoming honors cohort filtering.
ICS export: valid text/calendar content-type, BEGIN:VCALENDAR..END:VCALENDAR envelope, DTSTART/DTEND/SUMMARY present.

Frontend: marketplace-hero, featured-section, cta-enroll, marketplace-opt-in-row, new-session-btn, create-session-modal, input-title, input-meeting-url, input-start-at, submit-session all present with correct data-testids.
Anonymous → signup handoff: clicking Enrol on /catalog/159 correctly redirects to /register?next=/catalog/159&auto_enroll=1.
Role-based UI on /live-sessions: admin gets Schedule/Attendance/delete; learner gets RSVP/.ics only (no new-session-btn, no Attendance). Verified.
RSVP toggle: 'RSVP' → click → 'RSVP'd' → click → 'RSVP' with 'RSVP cancelled' toast. Cohort filtering server-side confirmed.
Modal field-testids are input-title / input-meeting-url / input-start-at (not session-title as review-request loosely described). This is a doc mismatch, not a bug — actual DOM has correct testids.

Test suite is self-cleaning: session_id fixture deletes on teardown, marketplace_opt_in test restores in finally block. Verified admin@ifpi.org 2FA remains disabled, marketplace_opt_in remains True, LiveSessions count=0 post-teardown.
